answer_1.quote: Eight representative tasks including reasoning, natural language inference, open-domain QA, closed-domain QA, dialogue, summarization, named entity recognition, and sentiment analysis are employed to understand the impact of model editing on the general abilities of LLMs.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates the impact of model editing on the outputs of LLMs for these tasks, particularly looking at whether editing hurts the general abilities of the models.
